text:
maria: Opening thread for the new 'gpu-garden' cloud project + VNet warmup in ap-northeast-3. Goal: account/project + VNet, basic IAM, GPU quota uplift, smoke validation, and handoff to SRE. Pinging infra & cloud-ops.

ashwin: +1. Can you paste the minimal checklist? I can take quota requests.

maria: Checklist draft:
- create GCP project: redwood-gpu-garden
- org policy + billing link
- VPC with 3 subnets (control/bastion, worker, services) across azs
- subnet CIDR plan (avoid overlap with customer peering ranges)
- NAT / egress & routing (shared nat-gw in landing zone)
- firewall (ssh bastion, mgmt, node health checks)
- service accounts + least-priv roles
- GPU quota request (A100/T4 depending on sku)
- terraform module apply (infra repo)
- smoke: create k8s node pool, run nvidia-smi, run perf-fanout test
- cost estimate and tagging

kevin: Re subnet math — propose: VPC /20 -> 172.31.0.0/20; control: /26, worker pools: /19 split into 3 AZs (worker-a /21, worker-b /21, worker-c /21), services: /24. Keep a /22 reserved for future. Avoid 10.0.0.0/8 conflicts.

maria: Terraform snippet for project + vpc (from infra-modules):
```hcl
module \"project\" {
  source = \"git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/infra-modules.git//gcp/project\"
  project_id = \"redwood-gpu-garden\"
  billing_account = var.billing_account
}
module \"vpc\" {
  source = \"git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/infra-modules.git//gcp/vpc\"
  project = module.project.project_id
  cidr = \"172.31.0.0/20\"
  subnets = { control = \"172.31.0.0/26\" services = \"172.31.1.0/24\" workers = [\"172.31.8.0/21\",\"172.31.16.0/21\",\"172.31.24.0/21\"] }
}
```

ashwin: I'll open the quota ticket. Which GPU types? A100 80GB preferred for prod; use T4 for dev/burst. I'll request initial: 8 A100-80GB, 32 T4.

quota-bot: Quota request Q-84921 created by @ashwin for project redwood-gpu-garden. Estimated review time 72h. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=redwood-gpu-garden

ops: Heads-up: if this region doesn't have regional egress pricing parity, traffic to our data backplane may spike. Add a cost checkpoint after smoke.

maria: Validation plan (short):
1) terraform plan/apply in staging infra account (run with service account creds)
2) verify subnets + routes: `gcloud compute networks subnets list --filter=redwood-gpu-garden`
3) create GKE node pool (cos-custom + GPU taints), ensure node comes Ready and `nvidia-smi` shows devices
4) run `kubectl apply -f smoke/gpu-test.yaml` (small matrix multiply workload)
5) run internal perf-fanout to measure cold-start latency (3 runs)
6) run e2e: image pull + model load (50MB model) to catch egress throttling

kevin: For firewall rules: allow health checks (GKE), SSH from corp VPN to bastion only, allow 10.0.0.0/8 peering from shared services, block all ingress otherwise. Tag resources with `team:infra` and `env:staging`/`env:prod`.

sre-oncall: Once smoke passes, handover steps for SRE: provide project id, VPC cidr, node pool sizes, GPU SKUs, quota ticket id, and cost estimate. We will run a 24h soak and enable monitoring dashboards: GPU utilization, pod OOMs, node restarts, network egress.

maria: FYI snippets to run quotas and project creation (GCP):
```bash
# create project
gcloud projects create redwood-gpu-garden --name=\"GPU Garden\" --folder=1234567890
# link billing
gcloud beta billing projects link redwood-gpu-garden --billing-account=0000-AAAA-BBBB
# enable apis
gcloud services enable compute.googleapis.com container.googleapis.com --project=redwood-gpu-garden
```

ashwin: I'll submit quota escalation for A100 + T4 now. Also adding TPU quota hold just in case (we won't use them, but prevents surprises).

ops: Can we confirm shared VPC vs host project pattern? We should use shared VPC host project already approved (redwood-land-1). If so, VPC should be in host project and service project gets subnets. Maria — confirm.

maria: Yes, use shared VPC pattern per platform policy: VPC in redwood-land-1, service project redwood-gpu-garden will get subnet attachments. I'll update terraform to use `host_project = \"redwood-land-1\"`.

kevin: Nice. After apply I'll run `gcloud compute instances create --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=1` in staging to validate device driver install path.

quota-bot: Update: Q-84921 status=UNDER_REVIEW. ETA ~48h.

maria: Next actions: (1) ashwin — confirm quota numbers and update ticket (2) kevin — review terraform and CIDR/route table (3) ops — double-check egress pricing note and prepare cost alert thresholds (4) sre-oncall — prep dashboards. I'll update this thread with apply logs. :white_check_mark:

ashwin: On it, I'll cc procurement for accelerated GPU SKUs pricing.

kevin: Starting terraform review now. Will push minor CIDR tweak if needed.

sre-oncall: We'll queue the 24h soak once we see successful node creation. Please tag me in the PR.

maria: Thanks team — will post apply outputs and smoke run results here.
